runtime_cards_policy: Use the frozen v2 Runtime Cards unchanged; v4 does not rewrite, expand, or tune cards against v3 results.

normalization.principle: Repair harmless JSON shape/bound deviations deterministically before asking the model to repair; never invent task semantics.
prohibited_repairs: Do not synthesize missing objective or primary_bottleneck.
Do not invent missing action content, actors, evidence, decision rules, gates, or rollback conditions.

fail_open.rule: If the planner is still invalid after deterministic normalization and one model repair, answer the original task through the Vanilla path instead of returning an empty answer.
fail_open.audit: Record planner error, normalizations, repair attempt, and fallback_used.

development_regression.purpose: Reliability regression only; v3 tasks are development data and cannot support new task-gain claims.
development_regression.required_before_v4_scoring: Both Generic Planner and Method Planner must produce valid plans on all 36 v3 tasks after normalization/at most one repair. Any planner error aborts the combined v4 workflow before held-out scoring.

heldout_policy.generic_planner_role: Compute-matched control that receives the same planner contract but no Method Cards.
heldout_policy.method_planner_role: Receives at most two frozen Runtime Cards selected by the frozen catalog-single Router.
heldout_policy.reasoning_policy: Strip provider reasoning blocks before judge scoring.
